headline: Romania Private Sector Credit Growth Rises 8.2% Year-on-Year in September
summary: Data from the National Bank of Romania showed private sector lending increased 8.2% year-on-year in September 2026 to 480.3 billion lei ($105 billion), up 0.7% compared to August.
why: Private sector credit expansion indicates domestic credit demand, banking system liquidity, and economic resilience in Eastern European emerging markets.
